title: advisory-wait-state.mts collaborator-trust discovery misses advisory-reroll: markers
body:
`advisory-wait-state.mts`'s collaborator-trust discovery never matches `advisory-reroll:` markers

## Problem

`src/scripts/advisory-wait-state.mts`'s `advisoryMarkerComment()` predicate,
used by `resolveTrustedCollaboratorMarkerLogins()` to discover which
collaborator logins should be added to the trusted-marker-actor set (when
`IDD_TRUST_COLLABORATOR_MARKERS` is on), only matches:

```ts
function advisoryMarkerComment(body: string): boolean {
  const normalized = String(body ?? '');
  return (
    normalized.startsWith('advisory-wait:') ||
    normalized.startsWith('advisory-wait-recovery:') ||
    normalized.startsWith('<!-- advisory-wait:')
  );
}
```

`advisory-reroll:` (added by AW6, `#1511`) is not in this list. A
collaborator whose *only* prior marker comment is an `advisory-reroll:`
marker is never discovered as a candidate for the collaborator-permission
check, so they are never added to `trustedMarkerLogins` via this path —
even though `marker-helpers.mts`'s canonical `OPERATIONAL_MARKERS` /
`IDD_AGENT_DERIVED_MARKERS` tables already recognize `advisory-reroll:` as
a first-class operational marker.

Practical impact: under `IDD_TRUST_COLLABORATOR_MARKERS`, a
reroll-only-authored marker's author can be excluded from the trusted set
computed by `advisory-wait-state.mjs` (the canonical helper-first path for
the AW1-AW5 protocol), purely because their evidence trail happens to be a
reroll marker rather than an advisory-wait/-recovery one.

## Scope note (found while working #1705)

This is the *code* analog of a doc-only gap already fixed in
`idd-template/docs/idd-advisory-wait-shell-fallback.md` (the shell
fallback's own `TRUSTED_MARKER_LOGIN_JSON` collaborator-discovery `jq`
scan) — see PR #1741 / commit `e65aeb01`. `audit-pr-cleanup.mts`'s own
`isTrustedMarkerAuthor()` was checked and does **not** have this gap: it
checks collaborator permission for a comment's author directly, without
first pre-filtering by marker-type regex, so F4 cleanup itself is
unaffected. This issue is scoped to `advisory-wait-state.mts` only.

## Proposed change

Add `normalized.startsWith('advisory-reroll:')` to
`advisoryMarkerComment()` in `src/scripts/advisory-wait-state.mts`, run
`pnpm run build`, and verify `scripts/advisory-wait-state.mjs` /
`bin/idd-advisory-wait-state.mjs` regenerate accordingly. Check whether
`tests/advisory-wait-state.test.mts` already covers
`resolveTrustedCollaboratorMarkerLogins()`/`advisoryMarkerComment()`, and
add a case for a reroll-only-authored comment if not.

## Acceptance criteria

- `advisoryMarkerComment()` recognizes `advisory-reroll:` as a
  collaborator-trust-discovery candidate.
- A test demonstrates a collaborator whose only prior marker is
  `advisory-reroll:` is now discoverable via
  `resolveTrustedCollaboratorMarkerLogins()`.
- Generated `.mjs` artifacts (`scripts/`, `bin/`, `idd-template/scripts/`
  mirror) rebuilt and committed per `docs/typescript-sources.md`.

Refs #1705
